references.text: In [ref:Matt 26:17|Matthew 26:17], the disciples ask Jesus the same question: "Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?" This is the parallel account in Matthew's Gospel.
[ref:Mark 14:12|Mark 14:12] is the parallel account in Mark's Gospel, where the disciples ask Jesus: "Where do you want us to go and make preparations so that you may eat the Passover?"
In [ref:Luk 22:8|Luke 22:8], Jesus sends Peter and John with the task of preparing for the Passover meal, which is the direct reason they ask where he wants them to prepare it.
In [ref:Luk 22:10-13|Luke 22:10–13], Jesus gives a detailed answer to the disciples' question, instructing them to follow a man carrying a water jar, and everything happens just as Jesus had said.
